answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they are all at or beyond the system-prompted range. Top-1 agreement is 0.852 (system-prompted 0.861–0.908, fine-tuned 0.900–0.938). Sequence agreement is 0.312 (system-prompted 0.31–0.48). KL is 0.395 and TV is 0.152, both above the system-prompted ranges and well above fine-tuned (KL up to 0.205, TV up to 0.099). Token-DiFR gap is 0.691, also above the system-prompted range and far above fine-tuned (0.10–0.31). Raw-score shift ÷ TV is 3.3, which matches system-prompted (3.3–3.9) and sits at the low end of the fine-tuned range. Quantized and base are ruled out by the large KL and low agreement. Fine-tuned is the next closest, but the TV and KL are too large for it. The values overshoot the document's ranges, but the single draw of prompts could explain that.
